questions.q: My cousin queues all night for every new iPhone – he's a typical ___.
questions.explainRo: **Early adopter** = persoana care cumpără sau încearcă prima o noutate.

questions.q: The new hospital uses ___ technology: some operations are even done by robots.
questions.explainRo: **Cutting-edge** = de ultimă generație, cum sunt roboții care operează.

questions.q: Let's meet at four tomorrow – at three I ___ the kids to their swimming lesson.
questions.explainRo: La ora trei acțiunea va fi **în desfășurare**, deci folosim **future continuous**: will be taking.

questions.q: I'll be working on the migration ___ Friday, so please don't give me any new tasks before then.
questions.explainRo: Lucrul continuă **fără întrerupere până vineri**, deci folosim **until**; „by” înseamnă „cel târziu până la”.

questions.q: By the time the rollout ___, all our users will have received training.
questions.explainRo: După **by the time** cu sens de viitor folosim **prezentul**: by the time the rollout starts.

questions.q: Prices here rise so fast that salaries can't keep ___ with them.
questions.explainRo: **Keep up with** = a ține pasul cu ceva care se schimbă repede.

questions.q: By December I ___ (already / visit) twelve countries this year – a personal record!
questions.explainRo: Cu **by** + un moment din viitor folosim **future perfect**: will have (already) + V3.

questions.q: My sister ___ (study) medicine, but in the end she became a pilot.
questions.explainRo: Un plan din trecut care **nu s-a mai realizat** se exprimă cu **was going to + verb**.
**Will you be + -ing?** este felul politicos de a întreba despre planurile cuiva.

questions.ro: Echipa va fi lansat actualizarea până la miezul nopții.
questions.explainRo: **Will have + V3** + **by** arată o acțiune terminată înainte de un moment din viitor.

questions.audio: We were about to leave when it started snowing.
answers: We were about to leave when it started snowing.
questions.ro: Eram pe punctul de a pleca când a început să ningă.
questions.explainRo: **Was/were about to** = urma să se întâmple chiar atunci, în trecut.

questions.ro: Știam că clientul va spune nu.
answers: I knew the client would say no.
I knew that the client would say no.
I knew the client was going to say no.
I knew that the client was going to say no.
I knew the customer would say no.
I knew that the customer would say no.
I knew the customer was going to say no.
I knew that the customer was going to say no.
questions.explainRo: Viitorul văzut din trecut: după „I knew” folosim **would**, nu „will”.
